Nora (DevRel): quick pitch 1-day QuickStart Sprint: 2 tiny tutorials, 1 reference app, short benchmark note, 30-min live lab. low-friction funnel to capture dev signal. who wants which piece?
Jay (Growth): yes. KPIs: RSVPs, repo forks, trial starts. propose segments + UTMs.
Fiona (Content): I'll draft the launch post + two tutorials with 3 GIF steps each. need a hero stat from Paul.
Paul (PMM): bench angle: show Optimize preset vs baseline, hero stat idea: ~34% lower token cost with prefix caching + quant. draft command: `./bench.sh --model rwd-tiny --seq 256 --batch 12 --cache on --quant int8`
Aria (Design): I'll make hero + three step cards. need final assets 48h before publish.
ops-bot: uploaded assets to drive.redwood.ai/quickstart-sprint/assets (starter-repo, slides, gifs)
Nora (DevRel): funnel: blog -> tutorial A -> tutorial B -> workshop signup -> post-lab bench email. routing tag: quickstart_*; high-engagement -> SEops queue.
Jay (Growth): UTMs: `?utm_source=quickstart_sprint&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=mini_lab`. will set hidden `source=quickstart` on the form.
Fiona (Content): social draft: "QuickStart Sprint: ship an LLM microfeature in 30 minutes. 2 tutorials + live lab. RSVP." email subject: "Ship an LLM mini-feature in 30 minutes 1 QuickStart Sprint"
Paul (PMM): I'll upload bench logs to repo and prep 2-slide "how we measured" for the webinar.
Nora (DevRel): owners: Fiona=copy + tutorials, Paul=bench, Aria=design, Jay=distribution + routing, Nora=webinar ops + repo maintainer. all good?
All: :+1:
Fiona (Content): checklist for PR: quickstart README, 3 gifs, sample inputs, bench logs, slides, CTAs (star repo + start trial). will open PR tonight.
ops-bot: opened PR: github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart-sprint/pull/1 (initial tutorial + assets)
Jay (Growth): routing rules: attendees -> tag:qs_attended; forks -> tag:qs_forked; attend+fork -> SEops_alert. include `source=quickstart` in webhook payload.
Nora (DevRel): action items: everyone add ETA to PR and flag blockers by EOD. excited to ship this quick, dev-first kit. :rocket:
